item.title: Gov. Gavin Newsom denied entry to a fireside chat at Davos
item.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom was denied entry to an event at Davos, according to posts he made on social media.

item.title: Yungblud 2026 tour: Full schedule, cities, and where to buy tickets
item.description: Check out all Yungblud 2026 tour dates, venues, and cities. Find out where to get tickets and how to score seats before they sell out.

item.title: Deloitte is overhauling job titles for its US workforce — here's why
item.description: The Big Four firm is giving its US employees a new job title, according to an internal presentation seen by Business Insider.

item.title: Jeff Bezos's grand plan for a satellite constellation to rival SpaceX is coming together
item.description: Jeff Bezos' space venture, Blue Origin, has unveiled a satellite network aimed at challenging Elon Musk's SpaceX dominance in orbit.

item.title: US authorities accuse a Canadian man of posing as airline staff to fly for free hundreds of times on US airlines
item.description: Prosecutors charged a 33-year-old man from Toronto with wire fraud, and accused him of posing as airline staff to score hundreds of free flights.

item.title: A new Guinness World Record shows how Ukraine's anti-Shahed interceptor drones have room to fly even faster
item.description: Ukrainian interceptors on the market can typically fly at speeds of up to 200 mph, but they'll need to be faster to catch Russia's newer Gerans.

item.title: James Cameron says he left the US and moved to New Zealand for his 'sanity'
item.description: Granted New Zealand citizenship last year, James Cameron says part of the country's appeal is that it 'believes in science.'

item.title: I moved abroad at 40 to escape loneliness. I didn't expect how hard it would be to go home.
item.description: Friends and family often ask Deidre Donnelly, "When are you coming back?" As she gets closer to 50, she finds the question hard to answer.

item.title: Lululemon's founder is blasting the company for selling sheer leggings, calling it a 'new low'
item.description: Chip Wilson said the "Get Low" sheer leggings recall was due to the Lululemon board's inexperience and shortsightedness.

item.title: Why Satya Nadella said he's psyched about more competition
item.description: The Microsoft CEO said current competition is intense, but that's not a bad thing.
